prBodyNotes: Check the release notes for components moving to PrimeUI PRO (paid) before merging. See AGENTS.md › PrimeNG licensing guards.

packageRules.description: PrimeNG minor and patch releases stay together so the theme and components match.
Every major update waits for approval on the Dependency Dashboard.
The jobs run on Python 3.15 (AGENTS.md); moving to a newer minor is a deliberate change, so only patch releases come automatically.

Angular's compiler accepts only the TypeScript minor it was built for (Angular 22: >=6.0 <6.1), so TypeScript minors and majors are not offered. Move TypeScript with Angular instead: when an Angular major's PR needs a newer TypeScript, bump it on that branch (`ng update` does both). Patches still arrive in the dev tooling group.
